gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (/eɪ/→[eː]). aští 'I want' — hallmark Ṣanʿānī šty verb (watson2002 s.v. šty). default pan-Arabic table (Watson2002/Holes2004).

gloss_en: my laptop doesn't work
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], coda cluster). mā ... yishtiġil negation. default table.

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imeːl. default table.

gloss_en: download the file and do an update
notes: [tech] file→fil; update→abdat (/p/→[b]). default table.

gloss_en: the wifi here is weak
notes: [tech] wifi→wifi (native segments). ض→/ðˤ/ — Ṣanʿānī ḍād–ẓāʾ merger (watson2002 §2.2 p.20). default table.

gloss_en: I want to buy a new mobile
notes: [phone] mobile→mubil (Latin-embed, nativised). aští frame (watson2002); jīm→[dʒ] in jadīd (watson2002 p.11, Ṣanʿānī palatoalveolar). default table.

gloss_en: send me the link in a message
notes: [phone] link→link; message→misadʒ (/dʒ/ kept). default table.

gloss_en: I saw the video on the internet
notes: [tech] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]); internet→intarnit. default table.

sentence: battery خَلْصَت وْ مَا فِي charger
raw: battery خلصت و ما في charger
ipa: batari ˈxalsˤɑt w ˈmaː ˈfiː ʃaːrdʒar
gloss_en: the battery died and there's no charger
notes: [phone] battery→batari; charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/dʒ/ kept). mā fī 'there isn't' (watson2002). default table.

gloss_en: take a screenshot and send it
notes: [tech] screenshot→sriːnʃut (/tʃ/... plain cluster; final /t/). default table.

gloss_en: I have a meeting on zoom today
notes: [tech] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); zoom→zuːm. diphthong aw retained in al-yawm (watson2002: Ṣanʿānī diphthong retention). default table.

gloss_en: the signal is weak and the download is slow
notes: [phone] signal→sinal (donor G2P, medial cluster); download→dawnlaud. ض→/ðˤ/ (watson2002 §2.2). default table.

gloss_en: my mobile doesn't work
notes: [phone] Arabic-script loan mobile→[moːbaːjil] (attested Yemeni/Gulf realisation, mid [oː]; Holes2004). Pipeline reads و as [uː]→almuˈːbaːjil (over-length ˈː artifact, WRONG); correct value pinned by hand.

gloss_en: I saw the news on the television
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan television→tilifizjuːn; sun-assimilated article at-t→[tt]. Pipeline matches attested → pinned.

gloss_en: my computer is slow
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan computer→[kambjuːtar]. Pipeline matches attested → pinned.

gloss_en: listen to the news on the radio
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan radio→[raːdjuː]; sun-assimilated article ar-r→[rr] (ر is a sun letter). Pipeline matches attested → pinned.

gloss_en: let me pay cash
notes: [commerce] Arabic-script loan cash→[kaːʃ]. Pipeline matches attested → pinned.

ipa: ˈkajf ˈħaːlak ˈjaː ˈʔaxiː ˈʕaːdak ˈzajn
gloss_en: how are you, brother? still well?
notes: [greeting] Ṣanʿānī Arabizi: 7=ح, 5=خ, 3=ع. Spells كَيف حَالَك يَا أَخِي؟ عَادَك زَين؟ (ʕādak 'still', diphthongs ay/aw retained; watson2002). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived from the Arabic.

gloss_en: I want to go to the market tomorrow
notes: [daily] Ṣanʿānī Arabizi: 7=ح. ashti 'I want' (hallmark šty verb, watson2002); soug=sūg (qaf→[ɡ], watson2002 §2.2); article el- realises Ṣanʿānī al- (not Levantine il-). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; hand-derived.

gloss_en: where's the key? I don't have it
notes: [daily] Ṣanʿānī Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع. wein=wayn (diphthong retained, not wēn; watson2002). Spells وَين الْمِفْتَاح؟ مَا عِنْدِي. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; hand-derived.
